pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with highly serrated, stellate, or oak-leaf-like margins. Sharp pixel-level gradients between dark patches and light interstitial skin. Patch area is largest on the upper neck and flank, becoming progressively smaller and more fragmented toward the rump and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Complex topological graph of light-colored pathways. Interstitial thickness varies from approximately 10-15 pixels on the neck to 2-5 pixels in the more densely patterned hindquarters, where junction nodes are highly concentrated.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette visible along the dorsal neck, representing a short, stiff mane structure against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A cluster of approximately five dark, hemispherical ectoparasites (ticks) is visible on the light-colored skin of the perineal region beneath the tail base.
other_distinctive_markers: Active excretion of fecal matter is visible at the posterior anal region.
